title: Countably many Lipschitz open chart pieces covering a C¹-submanifold cover inside U (Simon Ch. 3, Lemma 1.2 / Remark 1.3 local representations)
lean_statement: ∀ (n N m : ℕ) (M U N₀ : Set (Rn N)) (S : ℕ → Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ i, IsC1Submanifold n (S i)) → M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ i, S i → ∃ (D : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (ψ : ℕ → Rn n → Rn N), (∀ α, IsOpen (D α)) ∧ (∀ α, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (ψ α) (D α)) ∧ (∀ α, InjOn (ψ α) (D α)) ∧ (∀ α, ∃ K, LipschitzOnWith K (ψ α) (D α)) ∧ (∀ α, ∀ u ∈ D α, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ α) u)) ∧ (∀ α, ∃ K, LipschitzOnWith K (f ∘ ψ α) (D α)) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ α, ψ α '' D α
